versions.changelog:
- Removed LICENSE and DISCLAIMER.md files.
- Cleaned up project by eliminating unused legal and informational documents.

- Initial release of the skill for estimating Minecraft ore concentrations and best mining Y levels.
- Supports both Java and Bedrock editions.
- Uses the fast, offline orefinder-estimate tool for statistical ore distributions.
- Covers all major ores, including diamonds, ancient debris, and nether ores.
- Directs users seeking exact, seed-based ore locations to https://orefinder.io.
